nom: Good Molecules Bakuchiol Oil Blend for Dry Skin

avis.texte: I've only been using this a week, so some of what I see might just be a placebo effect. But I am absolutely loving how my skin looks!! It looks hydrated, glowing, and bouncy! I swear my crows feet and elevens look less noticeble too. But that's probably more in my head than anything. Haha. I randomly started having a bad reaction to all retinoids over the last year or so, and I was so frustrated with not being able to use a retinoid, I felt like I was really starting to see a decline in my 38 year old skin after being forced to stop using them. So when I heard about Bakuchiol, I ran right out to get some! And I'm SO happy I did. Not going to lie though, I was a little surprised with the laughably small container. But after using it for the first time, I realized that even the small container would last me a long time! I also love the smell. A lot of people on here seem to mention that they don't like it. But I think it smells clean and natural.

avis.titre: Visible improvement day 1 but is greasy
avis.texte: My skin is too sensitive for retinol. This immediately made a significant improvement on my shallow pitted acne scars and fine lines, and a little goes a long way. I just dont like that its an oil, takes like 10mins to absorb enough to finish my routine, but is still greasy for at least an hour before bed, and made my face the bad kind of shiny all day when i tried it during the day. When i apply to fingers as instructed i used 6-8 drops; when i apply to face i use 1 drop per cheek and less than 1 drop for the rest. Cant beat the price!

I started using this Buchoiol Oil blend because I cannot use Retinol. I have used this about 3 years and I have never had a problem with it on my very sensitive and dry mature skin. Very refreshing on my face, even the oil version does nit break out my skin.
This makes my skin feel incredible! It definitely tightened up my nasal folds and perks up my skin!
I can't speak to the efficacy of the product because the smell is rancid, fishy. I could not tolerate that smell on my face.

i never got to try the product my entire order came smelling strongly of febreeze or chemically. Unfortunately, this does not work with my health issues. customer service was helpful. But if you buy online and have any sensitivities be warned!

I bought this for my husband, who has a beard and also has dry skin. It works great on him! This is the second bottle we purchased. No dryness or flakes under his beard. This oil isnt greasy either. Would definitely be buying again
This has been my favorite face oil since becoming pregnant. Since I cannot use retinols this helps create a moisturized looked all day on my face.

I use this oil (and others by Good Molecules) after exfoliating. I have dry areas on my face and this helps in moisturizing. I use it daily as part of my facial routine at night. It works well as a last step with retinoid, vitamin c and other acid based products. Simple and effective.
I have very dry menopausal skin- THIS product truly hydrates.
The oil feels good & moisturizes my skin well. This is my second bottle.

avis.titre: Great for my dry sensitive skin
avis.texte: I use this as my daily moisturizer. I have dry / combination sensitive skin and can't use most serums. This keeps my skin hydrated and you can definitely see it improved blood flow and texture.
Good moisturizer, but it won't work miracles. (Don't expect it to replace retinol…). Tiny bottle—I flew through it!
On my third bottle. Just a few drops to gently pat on to finish my am skin care. Not too greasy, lightly scented.

Totally love this c product. Not only does it give your skin a super glow, it feels good on your skin as well as it smells good. It keeps my face moisturized throughout the day. And gives me that nice dewy look that I love

avis.titre: Not worth even the low price
avis.texte: My local Ulta was out of the Ordinary Rose hip oil I usually get, so was recommended this. Was first shocked at the extremly tiny bottle. The first use was underwhelming, my skin felt like I had put nothing on at all. I have fairly dry skin, so if you have oily/normal skin this product may be hydrating. For me, after 2 weeks of using I am just tossing the bottle out. My skin has stayed dry since using it, I went a few days without it and there was no difference in dryness. So it is as good as using nothing at all.

I'm so happy I got into skincare and that this was suggested to me. You apply this after moisturizer and it gives you such a nice glow. You don't need a lot. Maybe 1-2 drops. I don't mind the small bottle because this will probably last me for months. I've only been using this for 3 weeks now and it's been life changing for me. I, however, do not recommend this if you get hormonal acne like I do. I would halt it when you do get the breakouts :)
I have felt a difference in little as 2 week. Smoothwr pores. Radiant skin

absolutely hands down the best hydrating oil. Firming and hydrating all in one. I have used during the day in all different ways under makeup, after moisturizing and sunscreen, before my moisturizer, in-between my moisturizer and sunscreen, no other skin prep besides this, I have had no issues, other than don't get to close to ur mascara for obvious reasons. Best all day oil, especially for the price & amount. I also use with Good Molecules Squalane Oil. mix them together and magic. Mature Dry skin approved

I started using this product and loved it so much that I transitioned most of my skincare over to good molecules! I needed something other than retinol to use while pregnant, and I won't be going back to retinol after using this along with the peptides serum!
The first night i used this, the next morning my skin was soft and hydrated. I have not had dry skin since using this.
I love them all, but this one is my favorite so far. It is really good quality, and I can smell the rich Omega Acids in it.

I love this stuff so much. Its helped hydrate my super dry skin without making it oily! My only complaint is that it stinks. To me and my bf it smells earthy like grass, like my other rosehip oil smells. Not earthy in a good way and the smell lasts all day long. I constantly smell it while using. But i love this so i keep using it!

I was skeptical about using a facial oil as someone with combination, acne prone skin, but this product works wonders. I've replaced my harsh retinol product with a few drops of this oil in a lightweight moisturizer, and my skin has never been clearer or bouncier. If I've had a recent acne flare up, I'll use it overnight straight onto my skin, and in the morning my skin is moisturized and glowing, with significant healing of any problem areas. I have tried every moisturizer and every acne product you can imagine. I am actually angry that I spent years struggling with my skin without this. I'm not exaggerating when I say it's a miracle product for me.
I have a lot of serums for dry skin and this by far my favorite. Never stop making this! I add with my moisturizer. I wish they made a bugger bottle
I saw no difference whatsoever even though I really tried to … and smells horrible (not exaggerating) doesn't worth your money

I have bought this several times. It takes away the fine lines around the my eyes. I am actually buying it for my daughter to try. The price is very reasonable as well. Consider me a forever customer. The only thing I wish is that it had a bigger size

I love this product! It is so hydrating and moisturizing. When I use it, I have literal GLASS SKIN! I love that it has chia extract in it and my fav, rosehip oil. Has really helped me up my skincare regimen!

I bought this for my daughter. She has very dry skin. She also has milia under her eyes. She uses 3 drops for her whole face. The milia is slowly going away and she hasn't broken out or had an allergic reaction to the product. She puts a moisturizer 10 minutes after she feels it's "soaked in". She's very happy with this product.
Makes my skin feel so good, probably my favorite component of my skin care routine!! Makes me feel like a glazed donut in a good way lol
Love Good Molecules! I even have their fridge to keep the products cold. This oil is a perfect addition to my collection of their products.
I absolutely love this oil and use it nightly! Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Loved but had to let it go
avis.texte: In a nut shell.. This product is amazing. So hydrating and plumping. So manh serums and moisturizers but none compared to the glowy finsh this gave me. Unfortunately, i ended up being allergic to one of the ingredients and broke out in hives. Bummer.
I've been using this for a year. My skin is much softer, and it's required to make my 47-year-old face look like I'm maybe 35. YES and it's affordable!
Is this susposed to be bright yellow and smell terrible. I purchased The Ultimate Bakuchiol oil and it is clear and doesnt smell at all. Why is this?

avis.titre: Amazing for day use as a retinol alternative.
avis.texte: I will say, i honestly had zero expectations for this oil. Most facial oils are either too dry or too oily. She is just right with 3 drops for me. Warm it up real good in the palms of the hands and just pat, pat, and pat really well. Do not rub tho! It soaked in beautifuly. It is a great alternative for using retinol in the day. So you can still get great results day and night!
I have dry, insanely sensitive skin. This was too heavy for my skin, but every once in a while it helped with hydration.

I tried the Eqqualberry bakuchiol serum and unfortunately got perioral dermatitis from it. however, i loved the results of the bakuchiol because it made my skin plump, supple, hydrated and soft. so i bought this hoping it would work and it does to make my skin hydrated. i dropped 1 star because i dont feel like it makes my skin as plump and supple as the eqqualberry
Bachiol oil blend for dry skin is so good for my dry skin. My face feels dewy and looks radiant!

Three or 4 small drops to finalize my facial hydration when the weather turns chilly. Quickly absorbs into skin, leaves skin feeling well hydrated. It's great for travel, it's small, lasts much longer than expected.
I've been using this oil a little over 3 weeks and me and my skin love it. I'm 46 and the bounce it gives my skin is lovely. Leaves my skin with a beautiful none oily sheen

avis.titre: This is what helped transform my skin
avis.texte: This product has helped give my skin the moisture it needs!!! Such a game changer and has helped lead to glass skin. If you sugfer with dry skin, GET THIS and use it consistently.
I purchased the whole line but unfortunately it did work for me. My skin felt dry 😩
I have dry skin. I have tried a million face moisturizers and oils. This stuff is amazing
Light oil that gives a radiance to area of your face while working to do long term magic. Will buy again. My pores stay clean and clear when I use this stuff.

This is really baby's first anti-aging treatment for me, but it seems to work very well! Didn't want to try retinol because of the side effects, and other bakuchiol products seemed very expensive or cut with other actives I wasn't sure about. This is great! Super cheap and very simple ingredients. Honestly I think the oil is doing as much good as the bakuchiol... I have always had super dry skin, but after applying just a few drops of this at night I find that my skin feels super soft and dewy and I don't need to keep applying lotion anymore. Using with the Niacimide serum and I have definitely noticed firmer, smoother skin, with no irritation. Quite pleased.

I have tried many retinol and retinoid products. After going without due to pregnancy, I decided I wanted to try something again. I have used a retinol bakuchiol combination serum before and had luck but it also irritated my skin as most things retinol do. My skin has changed from combination to mostly just dry. I had a pimple happening near my nose. I tried this stuff last night and woke up to a clearer face and my pimple was gone. I realize most things take time to work but with this I already notice a difference without any irritation. Can't recommend this enough!

avis.titre: Love this for my dry patches
avis.texte: I have a hard time finding hydrating products that agree with my sensitive skin and actually last all day. I do like squalene but this feels similar and it is supposed to be similar to retinol without making skin more sensitive to sunlight. Not sure about the anti aging benefits just yet but I do love the long lasting hydration! Side note: I bought this in store and the smell doesn't bother me. Just wanted to mention since there are quite a few reviews mentioning it smelling rancid.

As someone with oily skin, I was apprehensive to get the dry skin version but still got it anyways… my skin is so hydrated and produces way less oil when I use this oil!!! My skin absolutely loves bakuchiol so I was super excited to try this. I am not kidding when I tell you that my skin is glowing, the cell turnover rate has sky rocketed, and my acne dark marks and scars are SIGNIFICANTLY lighter!!! I would recommend doing some research on the benefits of bakuchiol because its such an underrated skincare ingredient!! love this! GET THIS!!!

I've been using this for about a week and I love it so far. This has been a great addition to my routine and my skin has responded well to this oil. So far I've noticed reduced inflammation and my skin texture feels more supple. This one is definitely a keeper!

avis.titre: This oil is also really g
avis.texte: This oil is also really great! I like to use this in the mornings when I'm using "lighter" products

I pray they never stop making this. Tried many oils but this has been the missing key product. I have very dry, flaky, sensitive skin. This took a week to make my skin look almost flawless. My acne is basically gone, flakes are gone, lines look smoother, skin looks brighter, fuller, and healthier. I use a facial mist, Good Molecules' Peptide Serum, a light moisturizer, and then a couple drops of this. I'm 33 but my skin can't handle retinol and I've been kind of amazed at how much better my forehead lines look after a few weeks. I wear it night and day and it doesn't affect my makeup, if that tells you how dry my skin is. The price is phenomenal as well.
Perfect for my dry, mature skin Cruelty free, vegan According to Yuka app excellent product regarding the ingredients Very happy with my purchase.
I love this product. It's one that I always buy again. Gentle, non-irritating alternative to retinol, that keeps my skin looking and feeling healthy.
Fabulous pricing and a great little product. A little goes a long way!

avis.titre: She's an icon. She is the moment. She is my holy grail.
avis.texte: This FIXED my skin. Completely. I live in the northeast and these winters are BRUTAL and dry. So dry that I get perioral dermatitis toward the end of the winter. I used to use prescription creams to clear up the acne caused by EXTREME dryness. Since I've started using this product, I genuinely don't think I've picked up my creams. Yeah, it has a different type of a smell but it is not strong and doesn't linger. I would prefer this over added fragrance any day. It doesn't only help when you have it on, like soooo many skincare products out there. I use this every other night, and my skin feels so much less dry regularly, even out of the shower.

avis.titre: FANTASTIC ADDITION TO MY NIGHT SKIN CARE ROUTINE
avis.texte: I'm 49 years old and this has become a very important part of my nightly skincare routine. I love it and I recommend mixing a few drops with the Ultra Hydrating Facial Oil; Niacinimide powder and Hyaluronic Acid and facial moisturizer. My skin is so happy.

I cant say enough good things about this stuff, I think i'll riot if they ever stop making it. My skin is way too sensitive to handle retinol and is incredibly dry so I decided to give bakuchiol a try. I did have a little bit of purging but I think thats just because my skin is so sensitive and as that clears up my skin is noticeably brighter and more hydrated, any fine lines I had are almost gone, plus my discoloration/acne scars are so much lighter and I'm noticing significantly less active acne after just 3 weeks. I love this stuff!!!

Bottle is a lot tinier than I expected it to be. It also smells like fish oil. The fish oil smell eventually goes away once it settles into the skin, but don't know if that normal or if I got a bad batch?

I have eczema so my skin gets really dry in the winter. I had a really bad flare and my skin developed these two patches of super dry skin. I used this and the ultra hydrating facial oil and seriously the two patches were gone within 3 days. saved my skin.

For someone with extremely dry skin in the winter, sensitive skin & eczema on top of that it is so hard finding a product that actually stays on the skin and works!! This product has made my small patches of dryness literally go away. You cant beat the proce either. Will be trying other prodcuts from this brand.

avis.titre: This was a blind bye due
avis.texte: This was a blind bye due to its description. I must say I'm glad I took the risk! I originally tried the Rosehip Seed oil first and that was out of the gate amazing but now after using the Bakuchiol for Dry Skin I'm a changed woman lol Love it Good Molecules!
I love this oil especially when I am doing facial wood therapy or guasha
From having dry skin wether due to skiing or just winter cold air or swimming in a pool, this is it! I put this on as step 3 to my routine and love it!

I first used this in my skincare routine on my stomach throughout my whole pregnancy. This was my second pregnancy but I had found out beforehand that you could get more stretch marks the second, third etc time around. This product is amazing. I was way bigger this time, people thought I was having twins and not one extra mark. Even the ones I already had now look more transparent. I'm going to keep using this but also on my arms and thighs now too!

This is the first and only product I've found that actually diminished the size and depth of my "elevens" wrinkle between my eyebrows. It's so gentle and makes my skin glow—but give it a couple months and you'll really see a difference!

avis.titre: I'm so happy I tried it
avis.texte: Living in colorado with a very dry climate, this oil has been a godsend! I have always been very hesitant to use an oil with sensitive combination skin that can be so dry in the winter, but I have so much less areas of dry flaky skin on my face than past winters. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: I had high hopes for this.
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this, but my oil arrived rancid. It smells of spoiled fish and iit is impossible to use. I had a very nice customer service rep at Ulta who helped me with this issue. I hope Good Molecules checks their inventory often so this won't happen again. . Maybe in-store will be better to purchase this. I can check the quality before I leave the building.

Shipping was way too long. However, great customer service. Plain packaging. Product quality is excellent. The site have great deals but I prefer shop in store due to the long processing and shipping. Excellent products

This product leaves skin so smooth and hydrated. Feels a little oily going on, but your skin drinks it in quickly. I only use 2 drops. A dropperful is too much for me. I have used another brand of bakuchiol serum around my eyes and lips and I have noticed a decrease in the prominence of the fine lines with consistent use for the last 3 months. I use this on my entire face and hope to have the same results of my precious serum if not, that's fine because my this makes my skin feel great!

avis.titre: I've been adding a few dr
avis.texte: I've been adding a few drops of this to my nightly castor and black seed oil mix and feel like it's the right amount of extra for the winter to keep dry skin away
This oil is amazing! 2-3 drops does the trick with my moisturizer and my face stays hydrated for the night.
I mix this in with my moisturizer and I can't tell you the difference because I use other oils everyday from good molecules and my skin feels and looks good
I am pretty sure that this is my 4th bottle. It gently helps with wrinkles and post inflammatory pigmentation.

Some say this was drying. Perhaps due to Bakuchiol as it is "supposed" to work like retinol which can be drying? I have a retinal I must keep far from my eyes due to drying out oil glands in eyes (I have dry eye). I use a drop to enhance my moisturizer but not seeing a ton of good or bad results.
Great product for my easily irratated, sensitive skin. always wanted to use retinol, but it's just too strong for my skin and this is a great alternative for my also thirsty skin
My skin is extremely dry; especially between my brows, but it's working will definitely buy again.

My face is dewy and glowing. My fine wrinkles are vanishing. A little goes a long way, I only use about 3 drops. I've had the product for about 2 months and it's still pretty full. I absolutely adore this product.
I mix this with my moisturizer, am and pm. It adds just what my skin needs, as I'm very dry. Just purchased my second bottle about to finish my first!
I decided to try this oil for dry patches and it has smoothed my skin and it's lightweight and no irritation with my sensitive skin. 🙂

avis.titre: Great Stuff,  Need a Bigger Size!
avis.texte: This absorbs very quickly and is lightly moisturizing. I use 3 drops over my entire face. I use this instead of moisturizer under sunscreen. The first time that I bought this, I used this on just one side of my face for a few months. Unprompted, a close friend asked what I had been using on that side of my face because my skin looked more even and the few lines that I have looked lighter.
I love this oil so much. My skin glows after using it. And it feels so soft.

avis.titre: No, I would not-it made my eyes burn.
avis.texte: I used it for days, and my eyes burned! So, something in this is not agreeing with me.

This product has been really beneficial for my skin. I use it as the last part of my night time skin care routine and find that it is gentle enough for my sensitive skin. Another plus is that this product is cruelty free (very imporant to me). My skin stays hydrated throughout the day and feels so much better since using this product.

This product has helped my dry skin this summer! Usually I struggle to find something that moisturizes my skin without breaking me out because it can get humid in my area and this has done the trick. I am giving it 4 stars because I don't really see a difference in my hyperpigmentation but it does make my skin soft, smooth, and moisturized!
Omg this is miracle oil!! Ive been using it consistently and my skin is glowing! Definitely not a heavy duty retinol type of product but perfect for a similar, much more gentle effect.
Being over 50 and in menopause, boy did my skin change .. this is the first oil I've been able to use that my skin drank up and haven't had any breakouts and leaves a healthy glow.

avis.titre: I have repurchased this serum over and over
avis.texte: I have been using this serum for the past few years and it has made such a difference in my skin. It's very mild and has not bothered my extremely sensitive skin. I'm sure if you try this you will love it as much as I do.

I have been looking for a retinol replacement, since I live in the desert. i have gone through one bottle and wow!!! This has not only smoothes some of my fine lines, it has faded some sun spots I have!
I really enjoy using this oil. As someone with dry skin, I appreciate how moisturizing it feels and that it doesn't look greasy, just wish it had a little more in the container!

Amazing i will never stop buying this. After acne treatment with benzoyl peroxide, this oil along with squalene oil has restored my skin barrier to be healthy and moist even though i have a dry skin type!
I am using the Bakuchiol oil for dry skin and I absolutely love how my skin feels moisturized! My skin has a radiant glow as well. I will definitely keep using this product!

I used this paired with the gentle retinol cream and they both work so well! I tap this into the skin at night and wake up to genuinely different skin. I recommend trying this (and buying two at a time for people that like a lot of oil).
maybe i got a rotten one, but it smells very strongly and the scent lingers

Good Molecules products are all great. These products feel good on my dry skin and affordable. I hope Ulta will continue to sell this brand. I have ordered this brand directly from Good Molecules but love to just go into a store and don't have to wait on shipping

avis.titre: Bakuchiol is a MUST for aging skin
avis.texte: excellent! I must for over my moisturizer. Keeps my dry, mature skin dewy in this dry climate.

I am so sensitive to retinols; they always break me out, dry me out too much, or both. This oil has been so gentle but I feel like it has helped my fine lines. I only use it twice a week but that seems to be working for me. I also layer it over a hydrating toner as well. For the price, this can't be beat!
Feels super lovely and smooth on my skin, super hydrating and helps reduce wrinkles
Leaves my face feeling as smooth as a baby's bottom - not oily at all.
